cells.gaps: No source found names a second international fibre route in service; the minister said in November 2026 that the national backbone is connected to Guinea's, without saying it carries traffic abroad. A second landing is planned.
cells.note: ACE is the one cable named, and sources of 2024 and 2025 say the country has one international connection, so stage 2. The backbone link to Guinea is not shown carrying international traffic, so not 3.
